lee (sales): Heads-up — Acme POC seeing intermittent TLS handshake failures to our private endpoint under moderate load. Demo tomorrow, need quick triage.

omar (acct): Customer logs: 'tls: certificate not yet valid' and occasional 502/connection reset. DNS resolves to the interface IP.

tess (eng-networks): Can you share a curl -v and the FQDN? Ask them to tcpdump the ENI/NAT during a failure window. My suspicion: NAT egress churn or conntrack hitting max.

lee (sales): FQDN: acme-poc.rdwd-private.internal -> 10.12.4.9. curl shows 'SSL certificate problem: certificate is not yet valid' intermittently.

ana (eng-runtime): Our edge logs show tls handshake failures and some 429s from per-source rate limiting near the same timestamps. If their egress IPs rotate, bursts can trigger our limiter.

tess (eng-networks): Ask them to run: `sudo conntrack -L | wc -l` and `sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max`. Also `openssl s_client -connect 10.12.4.9:443 -servername acme-poc.rdwd-private.internal -status` to verify SNI/OCSP.

acme-ops (customer): Quick update: conntrack was ~64.8k (cap 65536). Increased nf_conntrack_max to 200k and retesting now.

edge-bot: private-endpoint service live (ips:10.12.4.8,10.12.4.9). cert managed by Redwood; OCSP stapling enabled; cert exp 2025-02-02T00:00:00Z.

acme-ops (customer): Retest passed steady traffic for 10m with no TLS errors. Looks stable.

lee (sales): Closing blocker for the demo. We'll follow up on PrivateLink if they want to avoid NAT in prod. Thanks team. :rocket:
